snapshot_scope: Historical checkpoint; original review and record pins retained.
limitations: Identifier review is not validation of every imported phenotype or completion of a whole-record review.
Reference locus identity is distinct from an exact tested allele, clinical donor or experimental subject.
Retained species TaxID 746128 and reference strain TaxID 330879 are grounded via cached UniProt taxonomy.
Source alterations, phenotype labels, assay flags and mechanism classifications remain unchanged.
No new subject label, allele sequence, MIC, breakpoint, strain TaxID, sample or genome was inferred.
The published sequence-project accession describes clinical-study data, not later experimental subjects; it is not an individual isolate, BioSample or versioned assembly accession.
Nine cohort associations remain pending; no partial-primary or citation-only review was promoted.
Four publisher Results were inspected via web; offline replay verifies bibliographic and UniProt pins, not uncached publisher text. Europe PMC OA=N does not imply unreadable publisher Results.
Metadata-only export: no protocols, sequences, primers, constructs or resistance-enhancement designs.
No NCBI endpoint requests, outreach, terms review, source adoption or GitHub mutations.
